title: Indian Street-Style Pav Bhaji
description: A flavorful and nutritious pav bhaji recipe that combines the crunch of fresh vegetables with the comforting taste of a street food classic.
instructions: Heat butter in a pan over medium heat.
Sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger until the onion is translucent.
Add the mixed vegetables, tomato, and bhaji masala. Sauté for 5 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked through.
Stir in lemon juice and adjust seasoning.
Split the pav in half and toast until crispy.
Serve the pav with the bhaji mixture and garnish with coriander leaves.
Optional: Add a dollop of butter on top for extra flavor.
